aforecapital-gamma-app:ashbyhq:4b2c8b10-.title: Engineering Manager, Growth
aforecapital-gamma-app:ashbyhq:4b2c8b10-.company: Pre-Seed Series a Series b Series c Series D Series E IPO Gamma AI Build beautiful presentations with generative AI. Bay Area
aforecapital-gamma-app:ashbyhq:4b2c8b10-.description: ABOUT THE ROLE The Growth team owns two areas that together determine how Gamma grows and how that growth turns into a business. Monetization builds the shared systems that power how Gamma monetizes. The impact here is multiplicative: the platforms you build unlock growth everywhere. These systems turn AI innovation into repeatable, scalable growth. Self-serve growth works directly on user-facing experiences: onboarding, activation, discovery, and lifecycle flows. This team's work directly shapes how users discover, adopt, stick with, and become Gamma champions. Our team has a strong in-office culture and works in person 4–5 days per week in San Francisco. We love working together to stay creative and connected, with flexibility to work from home when focus matters most. WHAT YOU'LL DO As the engineering leader across both areas, you'll: - Lead and scale the engineering team across both monetization infrastructure and product-led growth - Own the monetization platform: payment integrations, subscription management, billing, AI usage tracking and crediting, pricing systems - Own the growth surfaces: onboarding and activation flows, in-product education and discovery, lifecycle experiences, notifications, and messaging infrastructure - Collaborate cross-functionally across product, design, data, and other engineering teams. Partner on the full funnel: where users drop off, what the onboarding experience should look like, and where to focus next - Build and run a team that can move fast on experiments while also building durable shared systems - Mentor, coach, and develop engineers on the team - Contribute to broader engineering and EPD leadership by proactively identifying opportunities or misalignment and addressing them WHAT YOU'LL BRING - 5+ years experience as a senior+ engineer, 2+ years managing and leading high performing teams - Experience leading growth engineering, with a track record of moving activation/retention/conversion metrics - Experience with monetization or payments infrastructure (subscriptions, billing, app store payments, pricing systems) - Thinks deeply about product experiences and can look at a funnel and form a point of view on what to change - High cross-functional fluency - Comfortable pushing into ambiguity to find and drive the next big growth bets, even when the path isn't fully defined - Hands-on and technical enough to evaluate architecture decisions, guide the team’s technical direction, and review code, build prototypes, or jump in as needed COMPENSATION RANGE: The base salary for this full-time position, which spans multiple internal levels depending on qualifications, ranges between $250K - $325K plus benefits & equity. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including but not limited to experience and expertise in the requirements listed above. If you're interested in this role but you don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway! We're always excited about meeting great people.

getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:9a1ddc3d-c08.title: Product Manager - AI Sales Tech
getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:9a1ddc3d-c08.description: About the Role We are on the lookout for a talented Product Manager for our cutting-edge AI sales tech product, designed as a sales copilot for sales teams, executives, and sales professionals. This role is pivotal in shaping a tailored and targeted product that meets the specific needs of our users. If you have a passion for product development and an understanding of sales dynamics, we want to hear from you! This is an exciting opportunity to lead a full product and influence the direction of our sales technology offerings. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including design and engineering, to deliver an exceptional product that empowers sales professionals to achieve their goals.
responsibilities: Define product vision and strategy for the AI sales tech product.
Collaborate with sales teams to understand their needs and gather feedback.
Work closely with design and engineering teams to translate requirements into actionable tasks.
Conduct market research to identify trends and opportunities in the sales tech landscape.
Develop product roadmaps and prioritize features based on customer feedback and business goals.
Oversee product lifecycle from conception to launch and beyond.
Create and maintain documentation, including product requirements and use cases.
Analyze product performance metrics and iterate on product features based on data insights.
Coordinate product launches and collaborate with marketing for effective go-to-market strategies.
Act as the main point of contact for stakeholders regarding product updates and performance.
Facilitate communication between cross-functional teams to ensure alignment on product goals.
Support sales teams with training and resources to maximize product adoption.
Gather user feedback post-launch to identify areas for improvement.
Stay informed about industry trends and competitor products to ensure our offerings remain competitive.
qualifications: 1-2 years of experience in product management, preferably in the tech or software industry.
Experience working with design and software engineering teams.
Strong understanding of sales processes and the needs of sales professionals.
Ability to develop and communicate a clear product vision.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong communication skills, both verbal and written.
Experience with product management tools and methodologies.
Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:b3c4001d-004.title: HR Onboarding Specialist
getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:b3c4001d-004.description: About the Role We’re looking for an HR Onboarding Specialist to ensure every new employee joins Wing with confidence, clarity, and a seamless introduction to the organization. This role is a key part of the HR team, working closely with Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, and Organizational Development to guide new hires from offer acceptance through full integration. The HR Onboarding Specialist will deliver structured onboarding sessions, manage documentation and system setup, and ensure every new team member is fully oriented to Wing’s culture, processes, and expectations.
responsibilities: Manage and execute the end-to-end onboarding process for new hires, from offer confirmation to HR and departmental handover.
Conduct new hire orientations covering company policies, culture, communication standards, HR procedures, and performance expectations.
Ensure timely setup of system access, credentials, and HR-related accounts prior to a new hire’s start date.
Collaborate with Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, and relevant departments to verify completion of pre-employment and onboarding requirements.
Maintain warm, clear, and proactive communication with new hires throughout the onboarding journey, addressing questions and concerns.
Track onboarding progress, maintain checklists, and ensure timely completion of all required HR and compliance steps.
Collect, organize, and report feedback from new employees to enhance the onboarding experience and engagement.
Coordinate with People Operations and Compliance teams for documentation, contract execution, policy acknowledgments, and regulatory requirements.
Support new hires’ transition into role-specific training or departmental integration, ensuring no gaps in information, setup, or expectations.
Contribute to continuous improvement of HR onboarding processes, materials, and workflow enhancements.
qualifications: Minimum 3 years of experience in HR onboarding, training coordination, or HR operations—preferably in a BPO, staffing, or remote-first environment.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with strong empathy for new employees.
Highly organized and detail-oriented, capable of managing multiple onboarding cycles simultaneously.
Proficiency in Google Workspace, HRIS/ATS platforms, and onboarding or employee management tools.
Strong understanding of remote workforce practices and virtual communication norms.
Comfortable facilitating live sessions or presentations for groups.
Background in HR, Learning & Development, or employee training.
Familiarity with employee lifecycle processes, HR documentation, or learning management systems (LMS).
Knowledge of engagement, retention, and employee experience strategies during onboarding.
Experience developing onboarding documentation, guides, presentations, or multimedia materials.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:ca6a29a8-767c-.title: Staff Platform Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:ca6a29a8-767c-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Platform Engineer based in Switzerland. This is a high-impact platform engineering role focused on owning and scaling the infrastructure behind a developer-focused software platform. You will take end-to-end responsibility for cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, networking, data systems, infrastructure as code, and deployment foundations. A major part of the role involves turning BYOC and private-cloud deployments into reliable, scalable products rather than bespoke implementations. You will establish strong foundations for reliability, security, compliance, observability, and operational excellence as the platform grows. The position combines deep technical ownership with product thinking, giving you a direct influence on engineering priorities and company strategy. You will work closely with customers and a small, autonomous engineering team where initiative, pragmatism, and fast execution are highly valued. This opportunity is ideal for a seasoned platform, infrastructure, DevOps, or SRE leader who thrives in an ambitious startup environment. Own and scale the cloud infrastructure supporting the platform, including compute, networking, and core data-layer services. Lead the development of Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC) capabilities, including provisioning, upgrades, observability, and scalable customer-cloud deployments. Operationalize and productize Infrastructure as Code and GitOps foundations to enable a small engineering team to ship quickly and reliably. Establish reliability as a core product capability by defining meaningful Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and building trusted incident management processes. Own and scale critical data infrastructure, including PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch, and ClickHouse. Drive infrastructure-level security and compliance initiatives covering areas such as SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, penetration testing, and enterprise security reviews. Make architectural and infrastructure decisions that balance scalability, reliability, security, performance, and development velocity. Partner with engineering and customer-facing teams to understand operational challenges and turn customer needs into practical platform improvements. Contribute to the technical roadmap and broader company strategy through strong ownership of key infrastructure decisions. Support the engineering organization during incidents, help unblock complex technical issues, and promote pragmatic operational practices. Requirements 10+ years of experience in platform engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, or related roles, with a strong track record of operating high-traffic production systems. Deep hands-on experience with Kubernetes in production, combined with strong judgment around when Kubernetes is appropriate and when alternative approaches are better. Proven experience operating software in environments outside your direct control, such as BYOC, single-tenant, on-premises, or air-gapped environments . Strong AWS expertise, with familiarity with GCP and Azure considered an advantage. Advanced experience with Terraform , including reusable modules, secure state management, and multi-account cloud architectures. Strong database expertise, particularly with PostgreSQL , including performance optimization, migrations under load, replication, and operational reliability. Practical experience with security and compliance programs such as SOC 2, ISO audits, penetration testing, and enterprise security reviews . Strong understanding of infrastructure security, observability, incident response, deployment automation, and production operations. Familiarity with TypeScript and Node.js and the ability to understand application-level concerns from a platform perspective. jobgether-jobgether:lever:ea256064-b3d2-.title: Director of Finance and Operations
jobgether-jobgether:lever:ea256064-b3d2-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Finance and Operations based in United States. This senior leadership role will oversee the financial, administrative, grants, and operational systems that support a mission-driven organization. You will work closely with executive leadership, staff, external finance and HR partners, contractors, and vendors to ensure strong organizational performance. The position combines strategic financial management with hands-on ownership of budgets, reporting, grants, contracts, compliance, and administrative processes. You will help strengthen internal controls, improve systems, and ensure the organization has the infrastructure needed to grow effectively. The role offers broad visibility and the opportunity to influence how resources are managed and operational priorities are executed. Success will require strong judgment, exceptional organization, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities independently. You will join a collaborative, virtual environment where operational excellence directly supports meaningful mission-driven work. Manage the organization’s relationship with its professional employer organization, including payroll, benefits, paid time off tracking, performance reviews, onboarding, and offboarding. Maintain and improve shared digital information management, filing systems, financial records, administrative documentation, policies, procedures, and compliance records. Coordinate team meetings, retreats, performance review cycles, and related administrative processes. Oversee subscriptions, IT and administrative systems, contractors, vendors, and external service providers, ensuring performance against agreed scopes of work. Support pre- and post-award grant processes for incoming and outgoing grants, maintaining systems for deliverables, reporting deadlines, payments, and required documentation. Manage and track contracts with consultants, subrecipients, and vendors from development through completion and close-out. Lead financial reporting requirements associated with regranting and subaward monitoring while maintaining complete and accurate records. Manage external bookkeeping and accounting partners to ensure effective financial controls, accurate records, and reliable financial operations. Lead the annual organizational budgeting process and provide regular budget tracking and financial reports to budget owners, executive leadership, the Board, and funders. Oversee expense coding, allocations, reimbursements, monthly reporting, and other core financial processes. Monitor expenditures against grant budgets and prepare accurate financial reports for internal and external stakeholders. Ensure compliance with financial policies and applicable laws and regulations, while developing or improving internal controls and operational procedures as needed. Provide operational information and materials to executive leadership and the Board to support organizational planning and decision-making. Manage consultants and contractors supporting finance and administration and continuously identify opportunities to improve efficiency, systems, and resource allocation. Requirements 10+ years of relevant experience managing financial functions and organizational administration, ideally within a nonprofit environment. Demonstrated experience with financial processes, grant budgets, grant accounting, contracts, and organizational administration. Strong understanding of nonprofit operations, accounting, financial reporting, and compliance requirements. Experience managing restricted funding and grant-related financial reporting is a plus. Proven ability to independently own and drive complex finance and administrative functions from planning through execution. jobgether-jobgether:lever:eb81d97f-b7d1-.title: Director of Marketing
jobgether-jobgether:lever:eb81d97f-b7d1-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Marketing based in Denmark. This is a senior, commercially minded marketing leadership role focused on turning brand awareness into measurable revenue and scalable growth. You will own the full marketing strategy across acquisition, conversion, retention, lifecycle, brand, content, and community. As a player-coach, you will lead the Marketing team while staying close to performance data, creative execution, and optimization. You will work closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to support growth and expansion into new markets. The role combines strategic ownership with hands-on execution in a fast-moving, high-growth environment. You will also build the systems, playbooks, and processes needed to scale marketing efficiently across multiple locations. This is an opportunity for a bold, data-driven leader who knows how to build a memorable brand while delivering strong commercial results. Own and evolve the overall marketing strategy across growth, lifecycle, brand, content, and community, translating company growth and revenue objectives into clear priorities, budgets, KPIs, and measurable outcomes. Lead marketing analytics and reporting, maintaining clear visibility into channel performance, customer behavior, acquisition, conversion, retention, and lifetime value. Develop a deep understanding of target customers and use behavioral insights to improve the full customer journey from discovery through purchase, repeat visits, and advocacy. Own profitable customer acquisition and ticket sales across markets, overseeing paid media, SEO, and other growth channels while driving continuous testing and optimization of CAC, ROAS, conversion, and LTV. Oversee e-commerce and digital conversion performance, including landing pages, offers, booking journeys, mobile experiences, and checkout. Build repeatable marketing playbooks for launching and scaling new locations, working closely with Operations to align marketing investment with ticket inventory, seasonality, and market performance. Identify and test new channels, audiences, offers, partnerships, and creative concepts to unlock additional growth opportunities. Own retention and loyalty initiatives across email, SMS, memberships, referrals, reactivation, and other lifecycle programs designed to increase repeat visits, frequency, and customer lifetime value. Use segmentation and customer insights to create relevant, personalized communications and partner with Customer Experience to translate feedback into improvements. Protect and evolve the brand as the business expands, leading content, social, creator, influencer, PR, community, and local activation strategies. Develop campaigns and experiences that generate genuine participation, conversation, sharing, and advocacy across markets. Lead, coach, and develop the Marketing team while maintaining hands-on involvement in execution and performance optimization. Manage agencies, freelancers, and external partners, setting clear expectations and holding them accountable for measurable results. Establish the right balance of internal and external capabilities as the marketing function scales. Build efficient systems, reporting structures, processes, and playbooks that allow Marketing to support significantly more locations without proportional headcount growth. Recruit and develop high-performing marketing talent and establish strong collaboration across Marketing, Operations, Sales, Customer Experience, Technology, and Expansion. Balance long-term brand building with the immediate commercial priorities of a rapidly growing business. Requirements 8+ years of progressive marketing experience, including experience leading, coaching, and developing a marketing team. Proven experience in a consumer-facing, multi-location, DTC, e-commerce, wellness, hospitality, or experience-led business.

southparkcommons-vmax:ashbyhq:025ba97e-9.title: Member of Technical Staff - RL Infrastructure
southparkcommons-vmax:ashbyhq:025ba97e-9.description: ABOUT VMAX Vmax is an applied research lab developing AI capable of open-ended learning. We are building systems to exceed humans in all capacities by optimising beyond the local maxima of learning from human expertise. ABOUT THE ROLE This role is for strong infrastructure engineers who can build the systems layer for RL at scale: distributed rollouts, training orchestration, inference, evals, data pipelines, observability, and reliability. You will create the durable platform that enables researchers and applied ML engineers to run, debug, and reproduce large-scale RL experiments. RESPONSIBILITIES - Build infrastructure for distributed RL training and inference across thousands of GPUs - Improve the reliability, debuggability, and throughput of RL experiments. - Build interfaces that allow researchers and applied ML engineers to launch, inspect, compare, and reproduce experiments easily. - Own infrastructure projects end to end, from architecture and implementation through deployment, documentation, and long-term maintenance. - Identify and eliminate bottlenecks in training, rollout generation, eval execution, data movement, and cluster utilization. - Maintain engineering standards for RL infrastructure, including testing, observability, versioning, and reproducibility. MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS - Strong software engineering experience. - Experience building infrastructure for LLM inference and/or RL training. - Experience with GPU clusters, distributed training, model serving, or high-throughput inference systems. - Familiarity with vLLM, SGLang and modern LLM-RL training frameworks - Strong understanding of system reliability, observability, testing, debugging, and performance optimization. - Ability to work closely with ML researchers and translate messy experimental workflows into durable infrastructure. - Experience building tools, platforms, or services used by other technical users. - Strong judgment around technical tradeoffs: when to prototype, when to harden, when to simplify, and when to redesign. - Clear written and verbal communication, especially around system design, operational risks, and engineering tradeoffs. NICE TO HAVE - Experience supporting research teams or fast-moving ML teams. - Experience at a high engineering bar organization where reliability, ownership, and code quality were central. - Evidence of strong independent technical work, such as open-source projects, infrastructure projects, competitions, or substantial systems built from scratch. - Experience reducing operational complexity in systems that had become brittle, slow, or hard to debug. ROLE SPECIFIC LOCATION POLICY - This role is based in our San Francisco office; for exceptional candidates we are willing to consider a hybrid arrangement COMPENSATION The expected salary range for this position is $300,000 - $500,000 USD
